notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Mage Knights! Patch 1.2 is now live!

Updates Include:
[list]
[*]Vampire's Touch quest and Spell has been added. This spell compliments physical damage play style but can be upgraded to leech Mana as well, giving spell casters an edge.
[*]Vitality Stat has been buffed to give 1 Health Regen per 10 Vitality. This effect ticks steadily on a time interval out of combat or once per turn in combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166741/b2eb5e2b0a1a79e40a322f27336abd3af7d5579e.png[/img]
[*]Soul Stat has been buffed to give 1 Mana Regen per 10 Soul. This effect ticks steadily on a time interval out of combat or once per turn in combat and will give players more flexibility to lean towards the magic play style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166741/d5bca194cf5f301e4d2912233af2ed6b21ff2298.png[/img]
[*]Brace/Ogre Strength spamming has been fixed and no longer stacks strength infinitely.
[*]Potion usage going into the negative should be fixed now.
[*]Shop Inventory no longer clears completely in a bugged fashion. (This may help with Player inventory not loading bug)
[*]Nemesis Rep Orbs have been buffed from 3 Rep to 5 Rep when each orb is consumed.
[*]Forsaken Journal Entries are now Collectible and can be viewed by opening the Main Menu while in game. After Lore is collected in the world the Player can Replay note audio at any time from this menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166741/77639e489fe5826d1206a64182860f158f62d0b9.png[/img]
[*]Patsy Witherbones now has a repeatable High End quest so players can continue beating the snot out of that poor old man to trigger his secret fight.
[*]Some World Text has been added to explain game objects better.
[/list]

I've not addressed the Equipment swapping at the shop or the Stamina Flask quest being repeatable just yet but they're on the to-do list as well as the plethora of other bugs still out there. In the future I will most likely be giving some love to spell casters among a few other bug fixes. Thank you all for your support on this long road!

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello again friends!

This was a small bug update to fix a few various items, however the main fixes are:

[list]
[*]-Stamina Flask quest rewards and other consumables should now be able to properly go into the player's inventory

[*]-Players can now gain Shield experience when blocking attacks. 

[*]-Leveling up now increases your attribute points by 2.

[*]-Getting stuck in a "Sacrifice Gem" loop at the shrines should no longer occur.
[/list]

I am aware there are is still a bug with item rewards spawning like crazy on some monsters. This may also coincide with not being able to use some consumables in your inventory, if this occurs then just save and restart your game. Thank you all again for your patience as I work to resolve these bugs!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings Mage Knights! I've been combing through the various bug lists that you all have been graciously sending me and I've been trying to get the most egregious offenders taken care of first. There will be more bug fixes to come but for now here's a list of bugs that should be fixed as of this update:

[list]
[*][u][b]Consumable Rework:[/b][/u] I've Reworked Potions in an effort to free up inventory space and have them not consuming more than 1 per click. A tutorial section has been added for them and you can access your consumables by pressing 'E' now.

[*][u][b]Multiple Save/Load Slots Added:[/b][/u] Your previous game save is located in Load Slot 1 when you load up the game now. You can rename your various save/load slots and take advantage of having multiple character saves.

[*][u][b]Iron Bark Set Fix:[/b][/u] The Iron Bark set will no longer curse your stats to go into the negative when equipping/unequipping. It is once again a good starter set.

[*][u][b]Shop Glitch:[/b][/u] The root of the Shop Glitch is still there but I have added a buyback option to regain any gear you may lose until this is remedied correctly. Any items you sell will appear at the bottom of the Shop Keeper's list of items.

[*][u][b]Cemetery Corpse Key:[/b][/u] The key on the body located in the Cemetery now drops the correct key to access the end game relic located behind the Living Tree in the Dark Forest.

[*][u][b]Infinite Loops:[/b][/u] The infinite loop caused  by entering town and encountering a monster at the same time should not occur anymore.

[*][u][b]General UI Improvements:[/b][/u] Opening the Infusion table and Blacksmith Crafting will now open your character sheet.

[*][u][b]Corrupted Earth Dungeon Portal:[/b][/u] Using portals to go to and from the Corrupted Earth Dungeon should not prevent you from accessing your character sheet and your main menu now.

[*][u][b]Fire Shrine:[/b][/u] The Fire Shrine should be able to be interacted with now in the Corrupted Earth Dungeon.

[*][u][b]Shield Skills:[/b][/u] Shield skills will now display correctly if you have bonus shield level added to your stats.
[/list]

I appreciate all your feedback and hope this patch smooths out most of the glaring issues you all have been encountering. Thank you for your patience and I hope you all continue to enjoy the game as more fixes and content are put in place!

notes.title: Update Revert
notes.notes:
Greetings Mage Knights, this revert should remedy the town walking glitch for the moment while I fix a list of bugs I've been collecting since launch. Expect another update sooner rather than later to fix the handfuls of bug reports.

Avoid using the Iron Bark set for the time being as removing pieces will bring your stats into the negative and the shop has been known to swap and sell items you're not intending to sell.

I very much appreciate your patience during these rocky first few days!
